response.overview: ‘Brillamento’ originates from sound improvisations guided by the sun as a creative beacon, during the sunset, dawn and solar twilight phases, over 24 hours and in different places, each chosen to capture the most powerful atmosphere.  This ritual experience generated a vortex of inspiration poured into the texture of 'Brillamento', beyond the boundaries of understanding in an atmosphere of mental and stellar synaesthesia.  Brillamento is an audiovisual installation conceived for holographic projection. The visual component was realized entirely through live-action high-magnification light painting — no CGI, no AI, no post-production visual effects.
